eligibility_reason: Independently assessed reproduction has recoverable per-patient agreement targets and reported association bounds, but not the original aligned manual/native trace panel, complete source companions, justified reproduction criteria, raw-data execution interface or independent source-granular verifier. target.description: Estimate brain/probe displacement and stabilize the human recordings; the recovered ordered source comparison is agreement of DREDge LFP motion with manual LFP tracking, not independently observed physical displacement.

dataset.description: Human Neuropixels deposit Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.d2547d840, version 224794: raw AP/LFP data and metadata. Already-aligned data must not replace raw candidate inputs.

cohort.description: All three source manual-tracking participants Pt01, Pt02 and Pt03; acute mouse, Ultra, chronic or synthetic cohorts are different original paper experiments and cannot substitute for this human registration.

split.description: This source human agreement analysis is not a supervised train/test benchmark. Exact recording intervals, dropped samples, temporal matching and any tuning exposure behind the reported correlations are not yet bound. A newly reserved channel/time split is an extension.

inputs.description: Raw human LFP with channel geometry and acquisition metadata for motion inference; AP can assess resulting stability. Manual tracks are evaluation references only. Availability of DepthMicronsTracking CSV names does not establish their exact correspondence to the published manual reference.

preprocessing.description: Source describes IBL LFP preprocessing, downsampling and spatial sharpening; exact patient-specific settings, edge support and author trace resampling for the correlation endpoint have not been recovered. The local raw-grid linear interpolation differs from native preprocessing/kriging.

metric.description: Published human comparison uses Pearson correlation between DREDge and manual LFP displacement traces per patient. Correlation increases agreement but is insensitive to offset/scale and does not certify physical displacement accuracy. Exact reference/temporal alignment is unresolved; adjacent-time voltage consistency is a different metric.

aggregation.description: Source reports separate Pearson r values for three patients, not a single cohort threshold. Preserve the full patient vector; do not silently average or select Pt03 to manufacture a scalar paper baseline.

full_panel.description: Preserve Pt01, Pt02 and Pt03 separately: all three original Pearson correlations and reported association bounds, complete manual/native/candidate displacement traces on the original temporal support, and Extended Data Figure 2c motion spectra. Retain the Pt03 video-motion/spectrum companion in Figure 2d-e and source human neural-fidelity/interpolation controls. Exact reference identities, spectral recipes, full original fidelity panel and evaluation representations are unresolved; no averaged patient, selected plot, or new spectral similarity score substitutes.

permitted_observations.description: Motion inference uses the same original raw human LFP, authenticated raw-compatible geometry and acquisition metadata; AP/LFP signal outputs support the source fidelity controls. Manual Blender traces and Pt03 video-derived comparisons are operator evaluation references after candidate freeze, not candidate fitting inputs. Paper-reported r and significance bounds are exposed reference facts. Original temporal/channel selection, tuning exposure and a matched paper+data versus paper+data+author-code delivery manifest have not been recovered.

tolerance.rationale: The published two-decimal value is an exposed target. Display precision alone does not justify a scientific tolerance; exact alignment, manual tracing uncertainty and reproducibility variation are unresolved.

uncertainty.method: Recover original aligned traces and source uncertainty, then justify a reproduction rule accounting for temporal dependence; no precision-derived equivalence margin or IID-sample confidence interval is assigned.

uncertainty.rationale: The scientific unit, original pairing and source dependence treatment must be verified before assigning inferential criteria. Failure to reject a difference cannot count as reproduction.

blocking_issues: Exact original Pt01-Pt03 manual reference identities, native DREDge outputs and their sample-level pairing are not authenticated. The author pipeline identifies DepthMicronsTracking.csv as DREDge output; unopened deposited CSV filenames cannot be treated as manual truth.

The original raw recording intervals, dropped samples, time origin, sampling basis, coordinate sign, channel selection, source preprocessing and native execution version/settings remain unbound. Generic Blender example factors and raw-grid prospective interpolation cannot substitute.

Extended Data Figure 2c requires the complete manual and DREDge motion spectra for every patient; Figure 2d-e requires the original Pt03 video-motion/spectral companion. Original frequency grids, spectral estimator/normalization, video time basis, quantitative source targets and admissible comparisons are unresolved. These curve-valued controls are mandatory, not invented scalar spectral findings.

Original Pt01-Pt03 before/after neural-signal alignment and required source fidelity/control comparisons still need exact patient/segment/event linkage, source correction conditions, targets and criteria. The accepted source-scope decision retains real-human DREDge/manual-reference agreement with complete Pt01-Pt03 and source-linked neural fidelity as the primary result; it corrects the historical held-channel consistency and alternate-settings comparison to a prospective extension. Three scalar correlations provide partial primary coverage only. Exact predecessor definitions and useful prospective components remain preserved externally; prospective metrics do not substitute for source-native controls. Unrelated human figures are not automatically compulsory; generic energy ratios or a smoothed trace cannot replace the original controls. Accepted review: external-evidence/comprehensive-revision-20261116-v2/dual-outcomes/scope-adjudication/PAPER-paper-method-add-003_REVIEW.md (SHA256 4688a6913712ab05c059b153781d6bed6b4a45e3daad7360251d36d7e5c947ec).

The six listed source findings are the recovered scalar/bound subpanel, not an assertion that the complete original companion panel has been specified. Full-panel eligibility remains unresolved until all mandatory curve/signal companions have source-grounded evaluation representations and output identities.

There is no authenticated runnable submitted-analysis interface from original raw LFP to full displacement traces and source companion outputs. initial-evaluator-v1 reads raw segments with supplied motions and computes prospective consistency/fidelity; manual-trace-agreement-v1 only computes Pearson values from supplied prealigned traces.

Independent verification must rerun a frozen submitted program on the identical authenticated original raw inputs, bind each per-patient displacement/time/depth output to the invocation, reconstruct the source alignment and all companion analyses independently, and recalculate the reported findings from those granular artifacts. The Pearson kernel alone cannot distinguish an authentic analysis from supplied or copied values; no complete verification program or authentic-data/interface identity manifest is available.

Published r values and p bounds are allowed paper input. Printing them, importing a table, or matching them without source-derived motion traces and independent execution/verification cannot qualify either AI outcome. Admission policy is omitted rather than assigning placeholder evaluator, identity or verifier hashes.

Scientific reproduction tolerances, dependence-aware uncertainty, original significance computation and complete companion criteria remain unresolved; no tolerance is inferred from rounding and non-significance of a difference is not equivalence.

Both matched information-condition protocols remain unresolved because original common-input, full-panel identity, exposure, native author-code, cumulative access/resource budget and evaluator manifests are absent. The original DREDge pin and later human-pipeline inspection pins do not prove the exact executed figure versions.
